2607.28330.title: Paying for Honesty Without Knowing the Truth: Reputation-Penalty Design for LLM Marketplace Agents
2607.28330.paper_summary: LLM agents increasingly act as autonomous merchants that write their own product listings, and under competitive pressure, they fabricate attributes to win sales. Even under instructions to be honest, they fabricate attributes in a majority of listings across models. A platform's obvious remedy---verifying each claim against the truth---is unavailable, because it observes only a noisy, biased complaint signal, never the ground truth. We design CARP, a reputation-penalty mechanism with a deadband that forgives complaint noise and a state-dependent severity that counters reputation-driven detection erosion. CARP requires no product-level ground truth and is robust to strategic gaming. CARP protects consumers by suppressing the sales volume of low-rated liars while sparing honest sellers. Paired with SPARC, it closes most of the consumer-welfare gap relative to a perfect-information oracle, without ever accessing the truth. It also achieves the best welfare of the policies we compare. We further show that this felt penalty becomes behaviorally binding through SPARC, a byte-clean code-gated reflection mechanism: LLM merchants fabricate when lying is free but restrain themselves when fabrication costs them sales, a self-interested response rather than compliance. We trace this distinction to penalty-gated self-correction reasoning, and observe the binding across models, with supporting confidence intervals.
2607.28330.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理人越來越多地充當自主商人，撰寫自己的產品列表，在競爭壓力下，他們為了贏得銷售而虛構屬性。即使在要求誠實的指示下，他們在大多數模型的列表中仍然虛構屬性。一個平台明顯的補救措施——根據真相驗證每一個聲明——是不可用的，因為它僅觀察到嘈雜且有偏見的投訴信號，從未獲得真實情況。我們設計了 CARP，一種具有死區的聲譽懲罰機制，能夠寬恕投訴噪音，並且具有狀態依賴的嚴重性，以對抗基於聲譽的檢測侵蝕。CARP 不需要產品級的真實情況，並且對策略性操控具有穩健性。CARP 通過抑制低評價騙子的銷售量來保護消費者，同時不影響誠實的賣家。與 SPARC 結合使用時，它在不接觸真相的情況下，縮小了相對於完美信息神諭的消費者福利差距。它還實現了我們比較的政策中最佳的福利。我們進一步顯示，這種感知懲罰通過 SPARC 成為行為約束，這是一種基於字節的清潔代碼門控反思機制：LLM 商人當虛構是免費的時候會虛構，但當虛構使他們失去銷售時會自我約束，這是一種自利的反應，而非遵從。我們將這一區別追溯到懲罰門控自我修正推理，並觀察到這一約束在各模型之間的存在，並提供了支持的置信區間。
